# uzc_network_categories (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud network categories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_network_categories" "all" {}

output "network_category_slugs" {
  value = [for c in data.uzc_network_categories.all.categories : c.slug]
}
```
